1.hero_title: THE FOOD STORY OF KUALA LUMPUR
1.hero_subtitle: Where Malay, Chinese, and Indian cultures created something extraordinary
1.hero_description: Kuala Lumpur isn't just Malaysia's capital — it's where three distinct food cultures collided, blended, and evolved into one of the world's most exciting culinary scenes.
1.intro_title: A CITY BUILT ON TIN, SHAPED BY FOOD
1.intro_content: Kuala Lumpur rose in the 1850s as a rough mining town. People came from everywhere — Malays, Chinese, Indians — each bringing their culinary traditions. Instead of staying separate, these kitchens began talking to each other, creating a food culture that exists nowhere else.
1.best_time_to_visit: Year-round destination. Best weather: March-April, August-September. Avoid: Monsoon (November-January).
1.getting_around: MRT/LRT: Efficient rail system. Grab: Affordable ride-hailing. Walking: Best for food tours — we cover 2-3 km at a leisurely pace.
1.what_to_pack: Comfortable walking shoes, light clothing (hot and humid), umbrella (sudden rain), appetite!
1.meta_title: The Food Story of Kuala Lumpur | Simply Enak Food Tours
1.meta_description: Discover Kuala Lumpur's unique culinary scene, where Malay, Chinese, and Indian cultures have blended. Join our authentic food tours.

2.hero_description: Penang is legendary for its food. Our Georgetown tours explore hawker centres, heritage shophouses, and family recipes passed down for generations.
2.intro_content: Penang, especially Georgetown, is UNESCO-listed for good reason — the food culture is extraordinary. Chinese, Malay, Indian, and Peranakan cuisine have evolved here for over 200 years.
2.best_time_to_visit: Best time: December to February (cooler). Food festivals: April (George Town Festival), August (Hungry Ghost Festival).
2.getting_around: Walking: Georgetown is very pedestrian-friendly. Trishaw: Tourist-friendly. Grab: readily available.
2.what_to_pack: Sturdy shoes, light clothing, camera (for street art), very large appetite!
2.meta_title: Penang Food Tours – Malaysia's Food Capital | Simply Enak
2.meta_description: Discover Penang's UNESCO-listed food heritage with local guides. Explore hawker centres, heritage shophouses, and family recipes.
